evidence.ACL: Complete ACL tear with torn fibers along the anterior intercondylar notch.
evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Grade 1 sprain characterized by periligamentous edema without fiber disruption.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear involving the body and posterior horn medial meniscus without extrusion or displaced fragment.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the central weightbearing medial femoral condyle towards the intercondylar notch.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.PF OA: Focal high-grade near full-thickness cartilage loss along the median ridge-medial patellar facet junction with overhanging edges.
evidence.Contusion: Low-grade osseous contusion along the posteromedial tibial plateau.
evidence.Fracture: Osteochondral impaction injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau.
